review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Read an existing paired restore job independently of unrelated new preview availability
review.notes: Follow up the independently reproduced P1 at exact Qf3dc7615. Existing paired pending ID must be checked first; a successful existing status does not require a new preview. If status fails, a read-only preview may still enable the existing explicit same-ID retry, never an automatic POST or new ID. Preserve original pending ID/revision, pairing token binding, owner-only, late-host epoch and original tests unchanged. When both status and preview fail expose a reachable read-only status retry. No-local-ID preview failure also has read-only retry. Keep local_record failures conservative, do not clear an unreadable pending record to enable a new request. Tests use actual sheet with synthetic Keychain/network/timers, including old Q target failure, late status after target change, and no real sessions/credentials/restore/service/deployment.

cases.description: Existing restore progress does not depend on a new preview
cases.setup: Actual RestoreSessionsSheet and isolated Keychain/client mocks; persisted same-pairing ID; old Q source before production edits
cases.action: Preview503 with status available; both reads fail then explicit status retry; no-ID preview retry; late old-host status; corrupt local record
cases.expected: Existing status is queried without successful new preview. Status success shows the old job and reachable check action; failure retains ID and reachable read-only retry without POST/new ID/clear. Unknown old target cannot update or route to the new target. Corrupt local record never enables a new POST. Original assertions and timers remain.
